title: The Gap in Knowledge Graph Reasoning
description: Investigation series title slide. Dark charcoal with SVG network of 10 paper nodes converging on a central crimson question mark.

title: How RAG + Knowledge Graphs Work Together
description: Three-card horizontal layout: RAG + Knowledge Graph = KG-RAG, plus a crimson challenge box showing the 3-hop problem.

title: Paper 01 — D-RAG: Breaking the Retrieval–Reasoning Silo
description: Amber evidence-tag paper template. Core idea: joint end-to-end training. Gap: flat Euclidean distances.

title: Paper 02 — CogGRAG: Reasoning That Checks Its Own Work
description: Amber template. Core idea: cognition-inspired self-verification. Gap: flat embedding index for verification.

title: Paper 03 — Goal-KG: Queries That Know What They're Looking For
description: Amber template. Core idea: SPARQL-like goal queries. Gap: vocabulary mismatch on exact predicate match.

title: Paper 04 — M³KG-RAG: Reasoning Across Text, Image, and Table
description: Amber template. Core idea: multimodal KG-RAG. Gap: separate flat vector spaces per modality.

title: Paper 05 — KG-RAG (Wang et al.): Two Channels, One Answer
description: Amber template. Core idea: dual BM25+BERT retrieval. Gap: equal hop weighting ignores distance.

title: Paper 06 — GraphFlow: Teaching the Model to Flow Through the Graph
description: Amber template. Core idea: flow-matching over graph edges. Gap: distributions modeled in Euclidean space.

title: Paper 07 — SG-RAG: Retrieve Subgraphs, Not Just Nodes
description: Amber template. Core idea: subgraph-level retrieval. Gap: 90% to 58% accuracy cliff on 3-hop.

title: Paper 08 — HyKGE: Hypothesize First, Then Search
description: Amber template. Core idea: hypothesis-first generation (Hy=Hypothesis). Gap: requires exact entity string match.

title: Paper 09 — KRAGEN: Step-by-Step Graph Search with LLM Guidance
description: Amber template. Core idea: LLM-guided hop-by-hop planning. Gap: embedding space resets each step.

title: Paper 10 — KG²RAG: Grounding Answers in Factual Graph Paths
description: Amber template. Core idea: path-grounded faithfulness verification. Gap: fails on sparse graphs.

title: The Pattern
description: Dramatic 2-column list of all 10 papers mapped to their flat-geometry assumption. Closing: One assumption. Ten systems. Zero solutions.

title: The Blind Spot: Hierarchical Knowledge Lives on a Curved Surface

title: Introducing: Riemannian Manifold-Filtered RAG (RMF-RAG)

title: The Solution: Poincaré Ball + Geodesic Retrieval Pipeline
description: Emerald theme. 5-step numbered pipeline on the left. Poincare disk SVG with Gene-Disease-Drug geodesic path on the right. Formula.

title: How RMF-RAG Closes Every Gap
description: Emerald theme. 2-column table mapping all 10 papers to their RMF-RAG fix.
